sections.name: goal
sections.value: pij ships pod and seed templates, a repo owns its copies, and a prime sets them up once.

value.title: Procedures in a template
value.done_when: A template runs a procedure of its own and one linked from the repo, and adopting it elsewhere reports the linked one as missing.

value.title: Shipped templates, adopt, diff and init
value.done_when: `pij community init` and `pij pod adopt` copy shipped originals into governance with their version, the repo copy wins and is named, `template-diff` applies nothing, and none of them launches a seat.

value.title: Export a pod and save a role as a template
value.done_when: A running pod with a seat added exports to a template that `plan` reads.

value.title: The build pod and the live-call pod
value.done_when: `pij pod templates` lists both, and each stands up and comes down on a test project.

value.change: Owner moves from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001, which runs the build of PRDs 006, 007, 008 and 010 (operator's approval, 2026-11-25).

Each step names its plan (253 to 256) and the blueprint 005 components it builds; s04 also rewrites the prime's community route (c-docs). Amended scope follows PRD 010's changelog (Jordan's ruling 2026-11-25, round 2; pod dogfood input 2026-11-25).
s04 back to in progress until PRD 010 req-06's live receipt is taken after deploy (B347-R1-06, pm-001 ruling).
s04 complete: PRD 010 req-06's live receipt is taken.
